items.title: 68252_Jay Cee
items.q: I asked J. C., what do you think of Bette Midler's recording of your "Empty Bed Blues"? And he said, "It's all right. She's doing it her way."

ctx.x: And then, of course, he talked about the command performance at Windsor Castle before royalty. And I think we have that on the tape in other places.

I asked J. C., what do you think of Bette Midler's recording of your "Empty Bed Blues"? And he said, "It's all right. She's doing it her way. That's the way it's got to be." I thought this was interesting because, of course, Bessie Smith sang that and it made her famous and made him famous. He went on, "An artist has to do it the way they feel it. Would you expect Bessie Smith to do it like Bette Midler? No. As long as artists do it sincerely and in their way. This is their day, now. Then someone else will come…
And I thought to myself, here is a man so flexible, so open, so unrelated to preconceived ideas, so content not to return to the way it was because he's so well understood
